{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

# Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
on: [push, pull_request, workflow_dispatch]
# Controls when the action will run.

jobs:
  # Allows you to run this workflow manually from the Actions tab
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      max-parallel: 6
      matrix:
        python-version: ["3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.14"]

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: "${{ matrix.python-version }}"
    - name: Cache pip dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install tox tox-gh-actions
    - name: Know your environment
      run: |
        cd $GITHUB_WORKSPACE
        echo
        ls -F
        echo
        env
    - name: Test with tox
      run: tox run --skip-env=py312-mypy

  mypy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Set up Python ${{ matrix.python-version }}
      uses: actions/setup-python@v5
      with:
        python-version: 3.12
    - name: Cache pip dependencies
      uses: actions/cache@v4
      with:
        path: ~/.cache/pip
        key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('pyproject.toml') }}
        restore-keys: |
          ${{ runner.os }}-pip-
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install tox tox-gh-actions
    - name: Know your environment
      run: |
        cd $GITHUB_WORKSPACE
        echo
        ls -F
        echo
        env
    - name: Test with tox
      run: tox run -e py312-mypy",
  "rationale": "The workflow repeatedly fetches Python dependencies (pip install --upgrade pip and pip install tox tox-gh-actions) in both jobs across a five-version Python matrix, with no dependency cache present. The repository has pyproject.toml, so a cache key can be pinned to the dependency manifest. This matches the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE pattern (cache dependency downloads) and the measured experiment example that adds actions/cache@v4 for ~/.cache/pip keyed on hashFiles('pyproject.toml') before dependency installation. Adding the cache step preserves all build/test steps, matrix coverage, permissions, and triggers; it only reuses already-downloaded packages.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2"]
}
